candidates.when: You have field values and do not need to supply schema metadata in this call.
You have field values plus a HashMap<String, String> of schema metadata.

decisions.comparison: Schema::new and Schema::new_with_metadata construct from fields; the latter takes explicit schema metadata. Schema::project selects columns from an existing schema, with metadata retention stated by its documentation. Schema::try_merge accepts an iterator of schemas and returns a Result, with compatible recursive struct-field merging documented separately. SchemaBuilder::finish consumes an existing builder. These five nominated routes cover the reviewed input choices; the retained 65-record neighborhood also includes accessors, trait implementations and other operations, which remain unreviewed alternatives outside this bounded task.

reversing_conditions: Explicit metadata input favors new_with_metadata over new.
Selecting existing columns favors project; combining schemas instead requires reconciliation evidence.
An existing builder can be finished without first reconstructing its fields.
